$comment: Expiring exceptions for scripts/audit-gate.mjs. Only for advisories with no published fix. Each entry needs a reason and an expiry date; when it expires the audit gate fails again until the entry is re-reviewed or removed. See docs/standards/agent-tooling.md.

exceptions.reason: picomatch ReDoS via repeated extglobs; every release up to the latest (4.0.7) is affected and no fix is published. It reaches us only through build/test/lint tooling (vite, vitest, vite-plugin-pwa/workbox, typescript-eslint, node-gyp) matching repository-authored glob patterns; it is not in the shipped bundle and never sees user input.
